finding: Phone-only Linga controls remain outside the 15 tested states
before: TV on Linga home (plus the situations and the map) with the phone busy, 14 states x {plain, menu} = 28 renders: phone-only 54, strays 14 (the phone's reply box, 'Your reply'), unrendered 14 (disabled actions with disabled controls, and a pending reply's home row). The 15 tested states: 0 / 0 / 0. uat-surface-test 12/14 with the new cases (11 and 12 red; guards 13 and 14 green).
after: Those 28 renders: phone-only 0, strays 0, unrendered 0. The 15 states stay at 0 / 0 / 0. uat-surface-test 14/14, linga-rules-test 51/51, desk npm test exit 0.
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set shrank: LingaPhone.tsx is untouched. The phone already draws its panels itself, so only the view had to offer them. (2) Commit order: the fixes go first (d3d7732 surface.cjs, 3818bb2 view.ts), each green against the existing 10-test suite. The red cases 11-12 follow in the test commit 1268ab6. Red-before was measured by swapping in ad6c731's view.ts and surface.cjs in the working tree and restoring them after. (3) Beyond the two named busy states (conversation mid-turn, check mid-question), case 11 covers 14: the learner's turn, a reply in flight, paused, quiz open, coaching, a moment, the check's question, a choose task, an unrevealed listening task, the verdict, the topics, the ask-goal. It also covers the TV on linga-scenes and linga-map with a live panel, each plain and under the menu. They all had phone-only controls and are all at 0 now. (4) The Playwright TV capture was NOT run; a server-side render diff stands in for it. No TV component changed. The TV markup differs only by data-rest (the resting ring) on an already-disabled first row button, in 8 of 132 renders, all with a reply in flight and focus -1: talk waiting (menu), scenes preparing, home preparing, map waiting. The phone markup is byte-identical in all 132.
notes: VIEW (desk/src/lib/english/view.ts): (a) lingaView's phone list now mirrors every panel phonePanel(s) says the phone holds, whatever the TV shows. talk: Resume while paused, Replay while coaching, else cue / Choose a phrase / the quiz's pick-phrase options / Pause & coach; then Repeat audio or Cancel pending turn (id cancel, cmd leave), Finish rehearsal (phone), and Retry preparing scene (retry-scene) when unprepared. moment: back. check: retry, hear-again, show-words, choose, dont-know, the verdict's see-topics and check-again, skip-goal, swap, agree, renew, stop or not-now, add-topic. onPhone now dedupes against the TV row AND the footer by identical run.command. So on the panel's own TV screen nothing new appears except a disabled Pause & coach during the quiz, which the phone already drew disabled. No new action ids; VIEW_ACTION_IDS unchanged. (b) Every conversation command on the phone list carries disabled: refused(action) from the turn table, with cue, quiz and coach also disabled while waiting. The check's buttons are disabled while lc.pending, as the phone has them. Case 11 asserts disabled === !accepts for every conversation action offered in those states. (c) answerOf follows phonePanel instead of s.screen. With the TV on home and the phone mid-turn, v.answer is the reply to the partner (or the check's answer). So the LT Character can reply from home, viewText prints 'On the phone: Reply to ...', and the PC test bar (LingaTestBar, dev-only, ?test=1) now shows its answer box on home too. (d) While the view is waiting (a reply in flight), every TV row action except cancel is marked disabled. The TV already drew them disabled (LingaTV: waiting && !cancel), so this only makes the view match. Its one visible effect is the resting ring noted in the deviations. SURFACE (uat/driver/surface.cjs): a disabled control is pressed (recorded, never posted) and tied to a disabled offered action that runs the same command; on the TV it is tied by label to a disabled row or footer action. Such actions leave `unrendered` but do not enter `offered` (the Character is not offered a refused action). A disabled control is never tied to an enabled action, never a stray, never phone-only. GUARDS: case 13 (a seeded enabled finish with a disabled control stays unrendered) and case 14 (a seeded stray, with no view offering repeat, is caught with the TV on home). Case 10 (phone-only seed) is unchanged and green. STILL OPEN, not in this finding: on linga-talk with an unprepared scene (no line yet), the phone's reply textarea is enabled although the turn table refuses 'turn' (409 'Prepare the scene before sending a reply.'). Typing is possible, sending is refused. The detector would count that textarea as a stray, and no case asserts strays there. It is a phone-side ReplyBox fix (ready is false but the textarea is not disabled). Also unchanged: the view's 'Finish rehearsal (phone)' label keeps its '(phone)' suffix for the LT driver.
